description: Makes the 60-second faceless dropshipping "guide" reel end to end: a viral-looking product hook, a laptop on a zigzag tablecloth with a hand pointing a marker at the product cost, the store price and the demand chart, then each step (research tool → store → AI ad tool → Instagram → supplier ships), and a night-skyline ending shot on an iPhone with "Comment GUIDE". Script template, AI shots on varg (Seedance 2.5, GPT Image 2.5, Wan 3, ElevenLabs), word-by-word lime captions, the comment-to-DM funnel. Use when an e-commerce seller, dropshipper, affiliate of a product-research or AI-ad tool, or course creator asks for a product reel like @tradelle's, "a reel showing a product, its price in China and on Shopify", a "comment GUIDE" reel, a laptop-and-pen screen walkthrough, or one such reel per product every day. Not for the hook alone (use varg-product-hook), talking-head UGC ads, or screen recordings of software with a cursor (find those with video-skills).
